description: The Real Estate Information Library is MLIT's site for real estate information in Japan, bringing together transaction prices, public land price data, disaster risk information, urban planning information and nearby facility information on one map. Users can search and download real estate prices, both transaction prices collected by questionnaire and contract prices, see summaries of land transaction prices in major cities, and search and download the national Land Price Public Notice and prefectural land price survey, including appraisal report data. A public API serves the price data, municipality lists, land price surveys, National Land Numerical Information and urban planning layers as GeoJSON or PBF vector tiles addressed by XYZ tiles where data have locations. Coverage: Japan. Access: map viewer and downloads free without registration; the API needs an application, after which a subscription key is issued and request rates are limited. Licence: terms of use not read. Caveats: transaction prices come from questionnaire answers, not every sale, and the API does not supply colour styling or locations for every layer. Simulation uses are land and property values for loss estimation, relocation and investment appraisal, alongside planning and hazard layers. Related records: PLATEAU 3D city models and the Japanese registry map data.
